review_notes: I read the whole file. It has one large proof, dyadic_entropy_contradiction. It also has a short wrapper, not_both_axis_nonBacktracking, and a short case split in directional_zero_one. Inside dyadic_entropy_contradiction, the calc chain for hdelta and hfinal and the casts for herr' and hcorr' are each used once. They are not repeated blocks. The two cases at the end of directional_zero_one (b = false and b = true) are short simpa calls on different API lemmas, so they are routine, not repeated nontrivial reasoning. The reusable machinery (window_count_lower, dyadic_delta_identity, dyadic_large_parameters) is already factored into EntropyUpperBound.lean. A grep over the project lean directory found these names used only in Main.lean, so I found no second proof that repeats the same reasoning. I did not search other files for similar arguments beyond that grep, so some uncertainty remains.
